details.title: About you
details.description: Tell us who you are in DeMolay. An administrator checks this against the member list.

account.title: Your account
account.description: Your email address becomes your username. We confirm both your email and your phone.

consent.title: Consent
consent.description: Read and accept the documents below. Your choices are recorded with the date and the document version.

verify.title: Confirm your email and phone
verify.description: Enter the code sent to each.

memberTypes.active: Aged 14 to 21, with a DeM ID.
memberTypes.senior: 21 or over, a former active member, with a DeM ID.
memberTypes.advisor: An adult who advises a chapter, with a DeM ID.
memberTypes.parent: The parent of a member. You will need your child's DeM ID.

fields.demIdHint: Your DeMolay International member number. Your chapter Secretary can tell you.
fields.childDemIdHint: Used to link your account to your child.

consent.placeholderDocuments: Prototype: the privacy notice, terms and photo consent are still being written. Use fictional details only.
consent.privacy: I have read and accept the privacy notice
consent.privacyHint: How Foundation DeMolay Bulgaria uses your personal data. Required.
consent.terms: I accept the terms of use
consent.termsHint: The rules of the member area. Required.
consent.photo: Photos of me may be shown in the member area
consent.photoHint: Optional: you can join without it. Photos of members never appear on public pages.

verify.simulatedBody: In production the first code would arrive by email and the second by SMS. This prototype shows them here.

done.confirmation: Your account is waiting for verification
done.next: An administrator will check your details against the DeMolay International member list and we will email you when your account is ready. Until then you cannot sign in.

errors.tooYoung: Members must be at least 14 years old.
errors.adultRequired: Advisors and parents must be at least 18.
errors.demIdFormat: Use letters, digits and hyphens only, e.g. DEM-BG-10421.
errors.consentRequired: You need to accept this to create an account.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many wrong codes. Start again to get new ones.
errors.expired: These codes have expired. Start again to get new ones.
errors.childNotFound: No member has this DeM ID, so the parent cannot be linked yet.

checks.activeTooOld: Aged {{age}}: active members are under 21. Should this be a senior account?
checks.seniorTooYoung: Aged {{age}}: seniors are 21 or over. Should this be an active member?
